prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Produce one polished ORIGINAL Chinese technical textbook illustration for an embodied-AI foundations article. Landscape 1536x1024, light paper background #f6f6f5, cobalt blue #0837a5 and ink #171415, a very small amount of neutral gray. Flat precise technical line illustration with clear schematic robotic arms and grippers, readable Chinese sans-serif labels, generous spacing, large lettering (readable when image is shown at 780 pixels wide). No brand, watermark, title banner, gradients, pictorial human brains, decorative circuits or tiny paragraphs. Content accuracy and straightforward reading order matter.
Draw TWO stacked rows explaining learning versus execution, with headings 训练 and 运行 at the left. Top row training: human teleoperation demonstration of a robotic gripper lifting a cup, a small collection of camera frames plus action trace, arrow labelled 学习 to a simple neutral network symbol labelled 策略. Text labels only 示范数据 and 更新模型参数. Bottom row runtime: at left a camera and tiny joint-state chart labelled 当前观测, above a speech bubble 拿起杯子 labelled 任务; both arrows point into a copy of the same policy network symbol labelled 策略; arrow labelled 动作 goes to the robot arm/gripper lifting a cup at right. A large return arrow from the robot/environment under the row returns to 当前观测, labelled 新观测. A short note under the runtime policy states 使用已训练的参数. The two rows must be visibly distinct and connected only by a single vertical arrow from the learned policy above to the runtime policy below. Do NOT send feedback arrows into training, do NOT suggest weights update every control cycle. No brain icons. Make the diagram feel like a clear research textbook illustration, consistent cobalt/ink line art.
